options: O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet, and our master Ibrahim, Your intimate friend, and upon all Your prophets and Your chosen ones among the people of Your earth and Your heaven, as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the utmost of Your knowledge, and the weight of all Your creations.
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ الْفِتَنِ وَعَافِنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمِحَنِ وَأَصْلِحْ مِنِّي مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْحِقْدِ وَالْحَسَدِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ طَبَاعَةً لِأَحَدٍ.
pairs.en: O Allah, protect me from the evil of trials, and grant me well-being from all afflictions, and set right of me what is apparent and what is hidden, and cleanse my heart of malice and envy, and do not place upon me any hold for anyone.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَتَرْكَ السَّيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الْكَفَافِ، وَالْمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ، وَالْفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ، وَالْعَدْلَ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ الْقَضَاءُ، وَالِاقْتِصَادَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى، وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ، وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الْجِدِّ وَالْهَزْلِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ لِي ذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I have sins between me and You, and sins between me and Your creation.
